issues.issue: General Fund budget-and-actual disbursement lines (pp9-10) are 2,698 short of the printed Total disbursements 7,637,187. The gap is in Central services: 2510 Fiscal services 129,408 + 2560 Public information services 3,720 = 133,128 on p9, but the combining schedule (p6) and statement (p3) print Central services 135,826. Every other function group ties to p6. The page itself doesn't add up (or omits a line), yet there is no report_discrepancies entry. The notes also wrongly say the schedule lines 'tie to combining schedule 7,562,187'; they sum to 7,559,489. Detail expenditures across all funds come to 9,711,487 vs statement 9,714,185.

issues.on_page: Capital outlay 1,373,033 (General 46,000; Special Building 1,327,033 = building 202,666 + Redemption of principal 967,538 + Debt service interest 156,829, p15)
issues.issue: Statement line mixes categories: 1,124,367 (82%) is debt service (principal 967,538, interest 156,829) per the Special Building schedule on p15, which prints the breakdown of that fund's line. The rules say a mixed line takes its dominant category (debt service principal) and is mentioned in notes, or it is split with split_from using that breakdown. As recorded, it is capital outlay with no review or note.

The report prints this line's breakdown (p8: proceeds from disposal of property 2,350, insurance adjustments 18,175, other nonrevenue 30,752; p16 Nutrition other receipts 14,200; p17 Cooperative other receipts 35,067), so it could be split with split_from into sale of assets / reimbursements/refunds / other. Keeping it as other (the dominant part) with review is defensible.

The rules list activity-fund spending under 'student activities'. The extractor followed the statement p3, which counts it in Student support services (also disbursements[1], 1,073,533 including 422,547 of activities). Judgment call.

These read like object lines (professional/contract services; construction/infrastructure or land and buildings), not function totals. 'not itemized' is defensible because they are function codes in the state chart of accounts (also applies to detail[58]). Also, the department is printed as 'Facilities acquisitions and construction'.
